title: Firmware Support Engineer
jobDescription:
Firmware Support Engineer
- Mobitech Home Life at Mobitech Careers Contact Employer Login Hamburger Toggle Menu Firmware Support Engineer We are looking for enthusiastic Firmware Support Engineers with an Electronics background to join our team. The selected candidates will provide technical support for embedded firmware-based Io T products, assist customers in troubleshooting issues, and work closely with the R&D team to ensure smooth product performance. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support for embedded firmware and Io T products. Diagnose and troubleshoot firmware-related issues reported by customers and field engineers. Assist in firmware installation, configuration, and updates. Test firmware fixes before deployment. Record, track, and escalate technical issues to the R&D team when required. Coordinate with Hardware, Firmware, and Service teams to resolve customer issues. Prepare and maintain technical support documentation and issue logs. Assist in product validation and basic firmware testing. Support field installations and remote troubleshooting. Conduct basic testing of communication interfaces such as UART, RS485, Wi-Fi, BLE, or Lo Ra (project-specific). Provide customer training and product demonstrations when required. Required Skills Basic knowledge of Embedded Systems and Microcontrollers. Understanding of Embedded C fundamentals. Knowledge of communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, RS485, or CAN is an advantage. Familiarity with electronics troubleshooting using a multimeter. Basic understanding of firmware loading and debugging concepts. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and customer-handling abilities. Willingness to travel for customer support when required. Educational Qualification BE/B.Tech in: Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE) Electronics & Instrumentation (E&I) Mechatronics Engineering Embedded Systems or related Electronics disciplines Benefits PF & ESI Health Insurance On-the-Job Training Career Growth in Embedded Systems & Io T Learning and Development Opportunities Job Category: Permanent Job Type: Full Time Job Location: Perundurai State Wise: Tamil Nadu Divison Wise: R & D Division

title: Firmware QA Engineer
jobDescription:
Firmware QA Engineer
- Mobitech Home Life at Mobitech Careers Contact Employer Login Hamburger Toggle Menu Firmware QA Engineer We are looking for a detail-oriented Firmware QA Engineer with 1 year of experience to validate embedded firmware for Io T-based products. The candidate will be responsible for testing firmware functionality, identifying defects, documenting test results, and ensuring product quality before release. Key Responsibilities Execute functional, regression, integration, and system testing for embedded firmware. Prepare and maintain test cases, test plans, and test reports. Verify firmware features against product requirements. Identify, reproduce, and report bugs using defect tracking tools. Work closely with Firmware Developers and Hardware Engineers to resolve issues. Perform validation on microcontroller-based embedded systems. Test communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS485, BLE, Wi-Fi, or Lo Ra (based on project requirements). Validate firmware updates (OTA and wired firmware upgrades). Conduct stress, endurance, and performance testing. Verify hardware-software integration and peripheral functionality. Maintain testing documentation and release records. Support field issue analysis and root cause investigation. Required Skills 1 year of experience in Firmware/Embedded QA Testing. Basic understanding of Embedded C and firmware development concepts. Knowledge of microcontrollers such as STM32, PIC, AVR, ESP32, or ARM Cortex-M. Familiarity with embedded communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS485). Experience using debugging tools such as Serial Terminal, Logic Analyzer, or Oscilloscope. Understanding of software testing methodologies and defect life cycle. Ability to write clear test cases and bug reports. Good analytical and troubleshooting skills. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Instrumentation (E&I), Mechatronics, or related discipline. Experience testing Io T products is an added advantage. Benefits PF & ESI Health Insurance Performance-Based Appraisal Learning & Development Opportunities Career Growth in Embedded & Io T Technologies Job Category: Permanent Job Type: Full Time Job Location: Perundurai State Wise: Tamil Nadu Divison Wise: R & D Division

title: Field Sales Officer - Drip Irrigation (DFlow Brand)
jobDescription:
Field Sales Officer
- Drip Irrigation (DFlow Brand)
- Mobitech Home Life at Mobitech Careers Contact Employer Login Hamburger Toggle Menu Field Sales Officer
- Drip Irrigation (DFlow Brand) DFlow, promoted by Mobitech Wireless Solution Private Limited, provides advanced drip irrigation solutions that help farmers maximize water efficiency, improve crop yield, and reduce irrigation costs through reliable and high-quality irrigation systems. We are seeking experienced Field Sales Officer to promote and sell DFlow Drip Irrigation Systems to farmers, dealers, institutions, and agricultural businesses. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in drip irrigation sales, system planning, and layout design. The role involves customer acquisition, field visits, technical consultation, and achieving sales targets while ensuring customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Promote and sell DFlow Drip Irrigation Systems to farmers, dealers, FPOs, institutions, and agri-businesses. Identify potential customers through field visits and market development activities. Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable drip irrigation solutions. Conduct field surveys and collect necessary site information. Prepare drip irrigation plans based on crop type, spacing, land area, and water source. Design drip irrigation layouts using standard agricultural and engineering practices. Prepare system quotations and Bills of Materials (BOM). Explain product features, benefits, and return on investment to customers. Coordinate with the installation and service teams for successful project execution. Develop and maintain relationships with dealers, distributors, and channel partners. Submit daily field visit reports and sales updates. Qualifications Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture, Agricultural Engineering, or any relevant discipline. Candidates with relevant experience in drip irrigation sales will be preferred. Experience 2-5 years of experience in selling drip irrigation products. Experience in micro-irrigation companies is highly preferred. Experience in field sales within the agricultural sector.
